rationale: At this pinned commit package-lock.json resolves lodash 4.17.4, affected by GHSA-jf85-cpcp-j695 (fixed in 4.17.12; https://osv.dev/vulnerability/GHSA-jf85-cpcp-j695). The source imports lodash and calls _.merge(message, req.body.message, ...) in routes/index.js (https://github.com/Snyk-learn/nodejs-goof/blob/d240896711e31c540fc1cab79ae2e4cf63f00b1a/routes/index.js#L347-L351); app.js registers that handler for PUT /chat (https://github.com/Snyk-learn/nodejs-goof/blob/d240896711e31c540fc1cab79ae2e4cf63f00b1a/app.js#L66-L68). This is a direct call to the affected merge API with request-body data.
